dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Um, not yet. At the moment, all I've found are these crabs.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Darn them, their pincers are plenty painful! And they'll pop right back up after a while even if you throw them to the shore.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: I'm in a bind as to how to take care of them, so why don't you take them? Mind you don't get pinched, though.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Do you need something? I'm a little busy...

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Can you not see that I'm looking for something?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: By the way... I wonder if you've seen a girl I know?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: She sometimes comes here for a stroll, always dressed beautifully — you can tell just by looking that she's from a well-to-do family.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Ooh... What's that? It's so shiny...

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Oh... Well, she's my good friend. I haven't seen her recently, though, because she hasn't come here in a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: I figure that she must miss me a lot, so she'll have definitely left a gift for me on the beach.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How can you be so sure?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: I know I'm poor but honestly, me and her are soulmates! We have a connection!

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: I come here to the seaside every single day to see whether she has left a message or a gift for me. My efforts will not be in vain!
